title: El Niño Health Vulnerability Atlas of India: code, results contract and aggregate data
description:
Code, every reported number and the aggregate data of a pre-specified synthesis of El Niño and health in India (manuscript; citation to follow). The synthesis compares the traditional Oceanic Niño Index, the Relative ONI and the Niño-3.4 anomaly across malaria, dengue and recorded heat deaths under a fixed decision rule; hindcasts malaria and recorded heat deaths with ENSO forecasts issued before each season, with a climatological comparator that separates ENSO information from other model terms; builds a State El Niño Health Risk Index for 34 state-level units with Monte Carlo rank intervals; consolidates the companion analyses' 2026–27 outlook by unit; and reports a rapid systematic review (PRISMA 2020, PRISMA-S).

Contents: the R analysis and the Python synthesis pipeline; the results contract (committed before the new analyses; later changes as dated amendments); every reported number (results.json) with its traceability table; aggregate tables and figure data; the review protocol, screening, extraction and evidence-gap map; the digitised IRI forecast archive with the source figures; and the El Niño Health Vulnerability Atlas of India (docs/index.html, a self-contained web page). No record-level or cluster-level data are included.
